title: How is King Von connected to Mao Zedong?
description:
Five real photos link Chicago rapper King Von to Mao Zedong, through Lil Durk, Kanye West, Donald Trump and Henry Kissinger.

King Von → Lil Durk → Kanye West → Donald Trump → Henry Kissinger → Mao Zedong

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
